rationale: Documentation edit across three files, no code paths touched, low ambiguity and low blast radius. local-code-fast, the previous cheapest local profile, was retired in STORY-035-8c with no substitute selected - that decision is out of scope for the MVP. local-general is the closest remaining fit for this non-code, chat-only need; its sole surviving candidate (qwen36-27b) covers everything required and more. cluster-only because the attempt should not depend on a workstation being awake. Empty fallbacks is deliberate: if the cluster GPU is unavailable this attempt should fail and be re-planned rather than consume subscription capacity a harder story will want. placement_required is true: local profile, so the attempt is placed before it is dispatched, under cluster-only.
